summary: Enhance your expertise in financial sector risk management with our comprehensive training course on risk-based supervision and enforcement strategies.
lede: Risk-based financial supervision focuses oversight on institutions and risks according to their significance. For supervisors and compliance leaders, this course covers assessing and rating institutional risks, setting supervisory priorities, and linking findings to proportionate enforcement responses, with practice in on-site and off-site monitoring and communicating decisions clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly assess institutional risks and make or influence supervisory and enforcement decisions.
audience: Financial sector regulators in microfinance, SACCOs
Heads and staff of risk-based supervision units
Compliance and risk managers in regulated financial
Financial intelligence, AML, and sanctions officers
Legal and enforcement officers in regulatory
modules: Identifying and Classifying Risks in Financial Institutions
Risk Assessment Frameworks and Rating Methodologies
On-Site and Off-Site Supervision in a Risk-Based Approach
Data, Reporting, and Analytics for Risk-Based Supervision
Governance, Conduct, and Consumer Protection in RBS
Managing Risk, Crisis, and Early Intervention
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial regulation and prior experience in supervisory or compliance roles within the financial sector.
